title: {name} invited you to connect on SimpleFit.

never.other_coaches: Anything you share with other coaches

signedOut.body: Nothing is shared until you accept. Sign in with the email address this invitation was sent to.

acceptHint: Accept stays off until you tick the box. You can end the relationship any time from Coaches.

profile.title: Finish your profile to respond.
profile.body: Your account details and fighter profile come first. You return here afterwards; nothing is accepted on the way.

mismatch.title: This invitation was sent to a different email address.
mismatch.body: If it was sent to another address of yours, verify that address to add it to this account, or sign in with it instead. Nothing about this invitation is shared with this account.

stale.title: What you would share has changed.
stale.body: Review what your coach would see and agree again. Nothing was shared.

limited.title: Too many attempts.
limited.body: Try again in a few minutes.

previewFailed.title: We couldn’t load the invitation.
previewFailed.body: Check your connection and try again.

unavailable.title: This invitation isn’t available.
unavailable.body: Ask your coach to send a new one.

tooYoung.title: Coach connections are for fighters aged 18 and over.
tooYoung.body: You can’t accept this invitation. Nothing was shared, and your coach isn’t told why.

language.title: This disclosure isn’t available in your language yet.
language.body: Approved languages: {languages}. Switch the page language to read it and decide. You can still decline.

document.title: Accepting isn’t available yet.
document.body: The disclosure for coach connections isn’t published yet. You can still decline.

missing.title: No invitation to show
missing.body: Open the invitation link from your email again. For your security it works only in the tab and for the account it was opened with.

accepted.title: You’re connected with {name}.
accepted.body: {name} now sees the fields you agreed to share. You can end this any time from Coaches.

already.title: You’re already connected with {name}.
already.body: Nothing changed: {name} keeps seeing what you agreed to share before.

declined.title: Invitation declined
declined.body: Nothing was shared with {name}, and the link no longer works.

unavailable.title: This invitation isn’t available
unavailable.body: It may have expired, been answered or cancelled, or the link is no longer current. Ask your coach to send a new one.

linkDoneHint: Review the invitation and choose whether to accept.
